headline: Mexican Peso Ends Week Down 0.8% Against Dollar at 18.66
summary: The Mexican peso gained 0.3% on Friday to close at 18.6601 per US dollar, but finished the week 0.84% weaker against the greenback according to Banco de México benchmark data.
why: The Mexican peso is the most actively traded emerging-market currency in Latin America, serving as a liquid proxy for global risk sentiment.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: Broader weekly dollar strength and volatile global risk appetite contributed to a 0.8% weekly decline in the peso.
